title: Specsavers (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle comic true story mother love Australian family character portrait unhurried self-deprecating
lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic, gentle and a little chaotic]
Wilma McIvor.
Corey's birthday.
Sends twenty-three photos.
Then counts them.

[Verse 1]
I sent you twenty-three photos for your birthday
Some of them from the day
Some of them from the garden
Some of them from the table
Where we sat for dinner
Then I counted
And I recounted
And I looked at the bottom ones
And they were Pete

[Verse 2]
Not one Pete
Not two Petes
Three Petes
At the bottom of the birthday photos
For your birthday
Which is not Pete's birthday
Pete's birthday is the twenty-sixth of November
Your birthday is the twenty-second of February
I am aware they are different days
I am less aware
Apparently
Of which photos are Pete
And which are you

[Chorus]
Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
Gotta go to Specsavers
Haha
Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
Sent them all with love
Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
The first twenty were right
Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
Haha
Love you
Gotta go to Specsavers
Haha

[Bridge - spoken, Mum's warm self-deprecating voice]
"Happy birthday my beautiful boy.
Living a dream life, love you sooo much."
That was the caption.
Then the twenty-three photos.
Then the counting.
Then the realisation.
Then: "Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
gotta go to Specsavers haha."
She laughed at herself first.
She always does.
That's Wilma McIvor.
Eyes wide open, slightly blurry,
full of love,
three photos of Pete.
The gardens still growing.

[Verse 3]
Pete received no birthday photos that day
Pete's birthday is in November
He will wait
He always waits
He is the oldest
That is what the oldest does
He waits
And trusts
That when November comes
His photos will be correctly his

[Chorus reprise]
Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
Gotta go to Specsavers
Haha
Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
The love was right even if the pixels weren't
Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
The gardens still growing
Haha

[Outro - guitar alone, warm and smiling]
Happy birthday beautiful boy
Twenty photos of you
And three of Pete
All sent with love
All from Mum
The gardens still growing
Haha
